title: The Mac app has a phone-style tab that mirrors the phone app (update thread, item walk-through, readout, simple answers) so TJ can take updates and issue work from the Mac when he chooses

requirements.text: The Mac app has a separate tab that shows the same update thread and item-by-item walk-through as the phone app, with the same simplified answers

answers.observed: desk-drive.mjs PASS (answers reached a fake Tally channel in formatAnswers form; main window fields identical before/after); DeskWalkTests 11/11; bridge tests 39/39; TJ used the installed build and approved
answers.cause: n/a: feature; the black screen and text-log ending TJ hit were from rendering the thread when idle, replaced by the phone dash
answers.absence: Not observed: Focus Mode's At work list with live sessions, Genlock-voice readout on the Mac (drives run silent), open time on TJ's Mac after the lastSeen fix
answers.assumption: Mine: a reply to a desk message is walked only on the Mac (phone gets walk:false); answering at the Mac tells the phone it moved on, dropping its older items. TJ did not choose this explicitly
answers.falsify: A desk-sent message whose reply the phone still walks, or a phone item lost that TJ never heard on the Mac, would break the routing assumption
